name: Yotia
description: A coastal nation where Urza wins the Warlord's daughter's hand and thrives; it falls to Mishra's dragon engines.

description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra attacks Kroog, left undefended by Urza's absence.
timeline.quote: allowing Mishra to launch an all-out attack on its capital

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Yotia Urza builds a huge machine to move a jade statue, wins the contest and weds Kayla bin-Kroog to gain a Thran tome.
timeline.quote: He succeeded and was wed to Kayla bin-Kroog

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins the Warlord's daughter's hand in Yotia and takes Tawnos as apprentice, while Mishra tames a dragon engine with the Weakstone and unites the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovers a dragon engine war machine and tames it with his Weakstone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yotia falls to Mishra's dragon engines, and Urza retreats to Argive where he is named Lord Protector.
timeline.quote: Urza retreats to Argive where he is named Lord Protector

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza tells Tawnos that Mishra is dead, killed years earlier by the Phyrexian demon, and says he must leave Terisiare.
timeline.quote: tells him that Mishra is dead but that the demon from Phyrexia had killed his brother years ago
